one_liner: Customer service software and support ticketing system with extensive APIs for managing tickets, users, and conversations.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth access tokens, basic authentication with email/password or email/API token.
verdict_reason: Zendesk provides a comprehensive REST API with standard authentication mechanisms (OAuth 2.0, API tokens, Basic auth) and robust documentation.

evidence.quote: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.
To authenticate API requests, use basic authentication with your email address and password, your email address and an API token, or an OAuth ...
Zendesk has both a Tickets API and a Requests API. A ticket is an agent's perspective on a ticket. A request is an end user's perspective on a ticket.
